first_missing_criterion: canonical BUILDING_PRESENT parcel AOI plus a Belfast City 2006 North East Zone-specific CRS declaration and archive-internal DTM tile filenames. This unused official Spatial NI NIMA Support glossary window confirms that Northern Ireland uses the Irish Grid Coordinate system and defines Digital Terrain Model through Digital Elevation Model terminology, but it is general Spatial NI platform guidance rather than dataset-specific Belfast 2006 metadata; therefore it cannot by itself establish TM65/TM75/EPSG for the North East Zone or any archive-internal tile filename, and no such value is inferred.
